items.text:
From the support queue, a customer named Priya Deshmukh writes about her phone upgrade. She says she used the automated chat tool on our site to compare trade-in values, and it quoted her $210 for her old handset. When she took the phone to the store, the staff offered only $150, saying the online estimate was out of date.

Priya is not angry—she just wants the online tool corrected so other customers aren’t misled. She included a screenshot of the chat and the store receipt. She asks that we update the trade-in values and reply to her within the week.

Our team has logged the issue as ticket #5573. The trade-in data feed was last refreshed in March, which explains the gap. We plan to refresh it tonight and send Priya a $60 credit as a goodwill gesture.

intent.requested_action: update trade-in values and reply to the customer
